# Superfiliate Partner API

> REST API for Superfiliate partners: customers, campaigns, conversions, orders, custom reports, and webhooks. Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer <client_id>:<client_secret>`.

- Base URL: `https://api.superfiliate.com`
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <client_id>:<client_secret>` on every request
- Full documentation as one markdown file: https://docs.superfiliate.com/llms-full.txt
- Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec: https://api.superfiliate.com/api/v1/docs.json

## Guides

- [Agent Guides](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/dry-run-api): Use agent-readable docs and dry-run requests to validate your Partners API integration.
- [Authentication](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/authentication): One bearer header, scoped credentials, and the endpoint access they unlock.
- [API Keys](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/api-keys): Create, copy, and revoke credentials in Settings → Developers.
- [Import creators and codes](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/import-creators): Migrate existing creators and referral codes with the CSV import tool or the API.
- [Sync discount codes](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/sync-discount-codes): Use code notifications and the API to create and update discounts in your commerce platform.
- [Import your product catalog](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/import-products): Import products and variants from your Custom OMS through the API, then choose them for gifting campaigns.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.superfiliate.com/docs/webhooks): Get customer changes pushed to your endpoint, verify signatures, and handle retries.

## API Reference

- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/attribution — Get attribution installation](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/attribution/dry-run-get-attribution-installation): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. For standard Shopify storefronts, the Shopify app manages tracking. Returns the shop-specific script tag used to install Superfiliate attribution tracking.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/campaigns — List campaigns](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/campaigns/dry-run-list-campaigns): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/conversions — Search for conversions](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/conversions/dry-run-search-conversions): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/conversions/{id}/reject — Reject a conversion](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/conversions/dry-run-reject-conversion): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Rejects one conversion, with the same rules and side effects as **Reject conversion** in the Superfiliate app.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/customers — Search for customers](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-search-customers): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/customers — Create customer](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-create-customer): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Creates a customer when the email is new.
- [PUT /api/dry-run/v1/customers/{id} — Update customer](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-update-customer): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Updates only the supplied code, first_name, last_name, email, phone, instagram_handle, and tiktok_handle.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/customers/{id}/enroll — Enroll a customer](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-enroll-customer): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Enrolls a customer to a campaign, if not already enrolled to a campaign.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/customers/{id}/add_balance — Add balance](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-add-balance): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Adds balance to a customer.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/customers/{id}/insights — Get customer insights](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-get-customer-insights): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/customers/{id}/redact — Redact a customer](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/customers/dry-run-redact-customer): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Redacts the customer's personal data and records the redaction request for future synchronization.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/discount_codes — List discount codes](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/discounts/dry-run-list-discount-codes): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Lists active discount codes for the authenticated shop.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/discount_code/{id} — Get discount code](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/discounts/dry-run-get-discount-code): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Returns one active discount code for the authenticated shop.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/gifting_campaigns — List gifting campaigns](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/gifting/dry-run-list-gifting-campaigns): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Lists seeding campaigns belonging to your shop, including campaigns without submitted gifts.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/gifting_campaigns/{id}/enroll — Enroll a customer in a gifting campaign](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/gifting/dry-run-enroll-customer-in-gifting-campaign): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Enrolls an existing Superfiliate customer in an active seeding/gifting campaign.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/gifting_rewards — List gifting rewards](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/gifting/dry-run-list-gifting-rewards): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Lists creator details submitted for merchant-managed gifting campaigns, including those run by Shopify stores.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/gifting_rewards/{id}/fulfill — Fulfill a gifting reward](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/gifting/dry-run-fulfill-gifting-reward): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Records fulfillment for a merchant-managed gift after the creator submits their details, including for Shopify stores.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/orders — Create or update order](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/orders/dry-run-create-order): Supported integrations: Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Configure a custom commerce integration before sending orders.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/products — List products](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/products/dry-run-list-products): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Only external catalog products are returned; Shopify catalog products are not included. Lists external OMS products and their variants for the authenticated shop.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/products/{id} — Fetch product](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/products/dry-run-get-product): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Only external catalog products are returned; Shopify catalog products are not included. Fetches one external OMS product and its variants for the authenticated shop.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/products — Upsert product](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/products/dry-run-create-product): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Imports external catalog products; it does not modify your Shopify catalog. Creates or updates an external OMS product by `source` and `external_id`.
- [POST /api/dry-run/v1/reports — Create custom report](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/reports/dry-run-create-report): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Creates a custom report that appears in the reporting UI.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/reports — List reports](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/reports/dry-run-list-reports): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. - [GET /api/dry-run/v1/reports/{id}/data — Fetch report data](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/reports/dry-run-fetch-report-data): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data. Runs a saved report and returns its rows.
- [GET /api/dry-run/v1/webhooks — List webhooks](https://docs.superfiliate.com/agents/reference/webhooks/dry-run-list-webhooks): Supported integrations: Shopify, Custom commerce. Compatibility refers to the production endpoint; dry-run uses fixed test data.
